contentBoundary: These guide records and their human-readable steps are data. The matcher, fallback resolver, composer, runtime token replacement, and troubleshooting decision tree are executable Rust behavior and are not duplicated here.

steps: Find the router administration address.
Open the port-forwarding area, which may be called NAT, Virtual Server, or Applications & Gaming.
Forward the selected server port to the host's local address and save the rule.
Open the mesh system's mobile app.
Find port forwarding or advanced networking.
Forward the selected server port to the host and save.
Open the Xfinity app or xFi web controls.
Choose Connect, then see network and advanced settings.
Create a port-forward rule for the selected host and server port.
Open the Spectrum router controls.
Find Advanced Settings and port forwarding.
Add the host and selected server port, then apply changes.
Open the AT&T gateway administration page.
Find Firewall or NAT/Gaming.
Add the host and selected server port, then save.
Open the Verizon router page or app.
Find Port Forwarding in advanced settings.
Select the host, enter the server port, and apply.
Open Cox Panoramic WiFi controls.
Find port forwarding under advanced settings.
Create and save the selected-server rule.
Open the ASUS router page.
Choose WAN, then Virtual Server / Port Forwarding.
Add a rule for the host and selected server port.
Open the TP-Link router page or Tether app.
Find NAT Forwarding or Virtual Servers.
Add and save a rule for the host and selected port.
Open the NETGEAR router page.
Find Advanced, Advanced Setup, then Port Forwarding.
Add the service and point it to the host.
Open the Linksys router page or app.
Find Security or Apps and Gaming, then single-port forwarding.
Enter the selected port and host, then save.
Open the eero app.
Choose Settings, Network settings, then Reservations & port forwarding.
Reserve the host if needed and add the port forward.
Open the Google Home app.
Choose Wi-Fi, then Settings and Advanced networking.
Add a port-management rule for the host and selected port.
Confirm which device is doing routing.
Check for double NAT or carrier-grade NAT.
Use the troubleshooting result before changing more router settings.
